title: Patch: Meditative+ balance changes III
thread:
**Issue #1828 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1828: Patch: Meditative+ balance changes III
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

This is the designer's third round of Meditative+ balance notes (2026-10-25), following #1563 and #1704. It changes 10 cards and tokens across Core, Classic, Classic+, Meditative and Meditative+, so it ships as one patch over all five sets. Each line below gives the card's current state on `main` first, then the change. A change applies to both faces unless the line says otherwise.

**Stats**
- **M #94 Shrinking Felinor**
  - Base: 9/9, down from 9/11.
  - Radiant: 18/18, down from 18/22.
  - See its text below.
- **C+ #30 Felinor Fuser**
  - Base: 1/1, down from 3/3.
  - Radiant: 2/2, down from 6/6.
  - The text is unchanged.

**Keywords and tags**
- **C+ #19.2 Jungle Loser** (token) gains **Can't attack** (§6.1). See its chance below.
- **C+ #61 Bauble Bubble** (Field Spell) gains **Brittle 1** (§6.1). At 0 it is destroyed, so its Death adds the Stockpiles.
- **C #80 BOOM! Big Max** gains **Crater** (§6.1). It keeps Tribute 3, Rush/Charge, Trample and Indestructible.
- **C+ #39 Book Worm** gains the **Plague** tag (§5: every card that uses Plague Counters carries it). Today its tags are `[]`.

**Text and play**
- **C+ #19.2 Jungle Loser**
  - Today its end-of-turn attack has a `chance` of 25%, or 50% on the Radiant face.
  - The chance becomes **100% on both faces**.
  - The rest of the text is unchanged. On the base face, a kill across from your Bot Loser sends it Berserk. On the Radiant face, your Bot Loser gets the kill.
  - Default reading: Can't attack stops only the attacks its controller declares. The end-of-turn attack is a forced attack, and R53 skips the attack validator for it except for §4.2 step 2's target restrictions, so the card still attacks every end of turn.
  - With Can't attack, this end-of-turn attack is the card's only attack.
- **M #21 API Key Fishing**, Radiant face only. The base face is unchanged at 2%, and 5% when Embiggened.
  - `chance`: 4%, down from 5%.
  - `paidChance` (Embiggened): 10%, down from 12%.
  - End of turn: it adds a **Radiant** API Key Fishing to your hand. Today the Radiant face adds a base copy (the script's header, R805).
  - Radiant text: "{chance}% chance: Steal your opponent's hand.\nEmbiggened (1): {paidChance}% instead.\nEnd of turn: Add a Radiant API Key Fishing to your hand."
- **C+ #43 AI Slop**
  - Today it fuses `cards` (3) random AI generated cards. Its pool is `{tags: [AI], token: true}`, all 14 of them.
  - It now fuses only **(1) Cost** AI generated cards. On `main` those are:
    - T-AI-01 Helpful Assistant
    - T-AI-04 Chain of Thought
    - T-AI-07 Alignment Tax
    - T-AI-08 Rate Limit
    - T-AI-09 Refusal
    - M+ #1.3 Garage Sale
  - The Radiant face still picks Radiant ones.
  - Base text: "Fuse {cards|random (1) Cost AI generated card|random (1) Cost AI generated cards} and add the result to your hand. It costs (0)." The Radiant face is the same, with "Radiant" before "AI".
  - Default reading: "(1) Cost" is the printed cost, as other cost-bracket pools read it. The tuned-to-1 branch (R582) reads from the same narrowed pool.
- **Core #51.1 KY's Empty Notebook** (token)
  - Today it says "Draw {draw}." (1 on the base face, 2 on the Radiant face).
  - Base text: "Shuffle 3 random KY cards into your deck."
  - Radiant text: "Shuffle 3 random Radiant KY cards into your deck."
  - Default reading: the pool is the non-token KY cards, since §5.1 keeps tokens out of a pool the text does not name. That keeps the Notebook itself, KY's Gift, Knowledge Breaker Prime and Lil' Kenny out.
  - The `draw` param is replaced by a declared `cards` param (3/3).
  - Use the engine's existing `shuffle_random` effect if it fits.
- **M #94 Shrinking Felinor**
  - Radiant text: the same as the base text, "Death: Summon a Shrinking Felinor whose base stats are this one's −{shrinkAttack}/−{shrinkHealth}."
  - The Radiant face therefore summons a **base** Shrinking Felinor, not a Radiant one. The chain then continues on the base face.
  - Default reading: the Radiant face keeps its own declared shrink, −2/−3, for its one Death.
  - The base chain becomes 9/9, 6/6, 3/3, and then nothing, since the next body's health would be 0 (R1181).
  - The Radiant chain becomes 18/18, then base-face bodies of 16/15, 13/12, 10/9, 7/6 and 4/3, and then nothing.
  - The PR states the chains it gets.

**Wording only**
- **M+ #4 Supply Drop** is renamed **Jlockeed's Supply Drop** (straight apostrophe, as in "KY's"). It changes `name` only.
  - Update every place that prints the old name: other cards' texts, §8.9's row, BUILD, `docs/radiant-audit.md`, `chinese.json`, `zh-CN.json` and the web's copy.
  - Under the classifier this is wording, not play.

### Notes for the build

- Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` before any card work (CLAUDE.md rule 10).
  - This changes shipped cards, so one pending fragment must claim every changed family, with its `player` note. Create it with `cargo jackioh patches "Meditative+ balance changes III" --plays …`.
  - `classify --claims` must agree with the fragment.
  - Where a script changes, older catalogs' replays keep today's behaviour through `KEPT_SCRIPTS` (R767000). The scripts that change are API Key Fishing, AI Slop, KY's Empty Notebook, Shrinking Felinor and, if its roll changes, Jungle Loser. #1704's `script_v0_4_0f` rows are the pattern.
- Keep these in step with the new behaviour: the catalog texts, the §6.1 keyword rows' Cards lists (Can't attack, Brittle, Crater), the §5 tags row (Book Worm's Plague, which settles #1704's open question), §7, the §8 rows, the BUILD rows, `docs/radiant-audit.md` and `chinese.json`.
- Any decision the spec does not make, and every ruling a change supersedes, gets a note from this issue's block, with a test named after it (CLAUDE.md rule 3). Candidates:
  - API Key Fishing's Radiant copy (an exception to R805's generated card being base);
  - AI Slop's (1) Cost pool;
  - the Notebook's pool;
  - Shrinking Felinor's Radiant face summoning a base body;
  - Can't attack leaving Jungle Loser's forced attack alone.
- Every new number is a named constant or a declared param (CLAUDE.md rule 9).

### Acceptance

- Every change above has a test in its card's file, covering the base and Radiant faces separately.
- Each test checks the new behaviour, not only the catalog field:
  - Jungle Loser can't declare an attack, and it attacks at every end of turn.
  - Bauble Bubble crumbles after a full turn cycle and adds its Stockpiles.
  - Big Max Locks its zone as it arrives.
  - AI Slop never picks a card whose cost isn't (1).
  - The Notebook shuffles 3 KY non-tokens on the base face, and 3 Radiant ones on the Radiant face.
  - API Key Fishing's Radiant face adds a Radiant copy.
  - Shrinking Felinor's chains match the ones the PR states.
- New and changed rulings have notes and proving tests, and `cargo jackioh spec index` has been run.
- These checks pass:
  - `cargo fmt --check`
  - clippy
  - `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`
  - `cargo jackioh catalog check`
  - `patches check`
  - `spec check`
  - `classify --base origin/main --claims`
  - `fuzz --seeds 200`
  - `golden check` (any re-bless explained)
  - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `test`
- The pull request lists every default reading it kept or changed.

### Open questions (a person may edit before the build)

- **Jungle Loser's chance:** the default keeps the `chance` param at 100 on both faces, so a Nerf can still lower it. The alternative drops the roll and the param, so the text reads "End of turn: This attacks a random enemy Unit. …".
- **Shrinking Felinor's Radiant shrink:** the default keeps −2/−3. The alternative reads "the same as the base text" literally, as −3/−3 as well.
- **KY's Empty Notebook:** the default fixes the 3 as a declared param that can be tuned. Tokens stay out of the pool.
```
